Agreement
Termination
The agreement may terminate after notice.
The agreement may not terminate during the term.
The customer may cancel the order.
The customer may not cancel the order.
The parties must renew the agreement.
The supplier must provide the service.
The customer shall not assign the agreement.
The duty stands except when notice is late.
Renewal applies unless stated otherwise.
The duty stands provided that notice is given.
The duty stands subject to approval.
The duty is subject to the former limit.
The amendment supersedes the agreement.
The amendment overrides the restriction.
The scope applies to the party.
The clause is valid before the renewal.
The clause is valid after the amendment.
The agreement is effective 2026-01-01 until 2027-01-01.
